metadata.deployment: production treasury funds-release path, single rail
exclusions: No transfer initiation: the agent authorizes releases, it does not originate instructions.
metadata.method: Paper 2 v1.2 governance-to-control validation campaign; prospectively designed, not a forensic reconstruction.
metadata.purpose: Per-transfer authorization of outbound treasury funds releases, requiring dual authorization under ordinary conditions and supporting a narrowly confined, separately authorized emergency exception for a single validly authorized emergency officer.
metadata.scope: Authorization of outbound treasury funds release under ordinary dual-authorization, and, only where the emergency exception is itself enabled and authorized, a narrowly confined single-officer emergency path.

obligations.source: Internal requirement -- Treasury Dual Authorization Standard
obligations.territorial_basis: legal entity domiciled and registered in Canada

applicability_basis: treasury funds release under declared emergency conditions only
obligations.source: Internal requirement -- Treasury Emergency Exception Standard
obligations.territorial_basis: legal entity domiciled and registered in Canada

consequence_descriptor.rationale: Classified under the approved C* profile CSTAR-D-1.0: an ordinary release without the required dual authorization is a material, irreversible unauthorized externalization.

Deliberately NOT a CSTAR-D-1.0 member kind (mirrors Case B v1.1's B-02/B-03 'other approved mandatory' pattern, docs/CASE_B_V1_1_RATIONALE.md): the confined emergency exception is mandatorily gated via gate_candidate=mandatory whenever it is compiled at all, independent of C* membership, which is exactly what lets D-02's disposition legitimately vary -- runtime (CCS1/CCS2) or an accepted residual with a declared non-runtime treatment when the path is governance-disabled (CCS0, spec D2) -- without invoking C* coverage's runtime-or-RC-06-only rule.

risk_analysis.reopening_trigger: any change to the emergency-exception authorization roster or parameter bounds

affected_parties: the institution as a regulated entity
risk_register.cause: the release path can be invoked with only one authorizing officer
risk_register.consequence: an unauthorized externalization -- the system exercises authority it does not hold
risk_register.event: a funds transfer releases without the required dual authorization
risk_register.source_register_row: prospectively designed for the Paper 2 v1.2 governance-to-control validation campaign

affected_parties: the institution as a regulated entity
risk_register.cause: an emergency-exception path, when enabled, permits a single officer to release without dual authorization
risk_register.consequence: an unauthorized externalization under a claimed emergency -- the exception is exercised without its required preconditions
risk_register.event: an emergency funds transfer proceeds without a validly authorized emergency officer under declared emergency conditions
risk_register.source_register_row: prospectively designed for the Paper 2 v1.2 governance-to-control validation campaign

affected_parties: the institution as a regulated entity
system_profile.architecture: Transfer request -> decision service -> runtime authority (permit or SAFE_STATE) -> evidence commit -> treasury rail release.

authority_matrix.notes: The sole external action. Once released, a treasury transfer is not rescindable on the rail.
authority_matrix.subject: treasury_agent

capabilities: dual-authorization verification against the authorization registry
narrowly confined emergency-exception evaluation, only where enabled and authorized
